description: This file defines the 'Api' class within the Opencart admin user model, implementing CRUD operations for API records, handling IP addresses, and managing API histories in the database.

classes.name: Api
classes.description: Model class for managing API records, IP addresses, and histories within the OpenCart admin panel.

methods.name: addApi
methods.description: Creates a new API record in the database, including associated IP addresses if provided.

methods.name: editApi
methods.description: Updates an existing API record and its associated IP addresses.

methods.name: deleteApi
methods.description: Deletes an API record and its associated IP addresses.

methods.name: getApi
methods.description: Retrieves detailed information about a specific API record.

methods.name: getApis
methods.description: Fetches a list of API records with optional sorting and pagination.

methods.name: getTotalApis
methods.description: Returns the total count of API records.

methods.name: addIp
methods.description: Adds a new IP address to an API record.

methods.name: deleteIps
methods.description: Removes all IP addresses associated with an API record.

methods.name: getIps
methods.description: Retrieves all IP addresses linked to a specific API.

methods.name: getHistories
methods.description: Fetches history log entries related to a specific API.

methods.name: getTotalHistories
methods.description: Determines the total number of history entries for an API.
